card.product: Discover it Cash Back Credit Card
card.product_version_note: Assumed variant: Discover it Cash Back (the it-card.html page names the product 'Discover it Cash Back Credit Card' and describes the 5% rotating-category program; it does not mention the Chrome, Miles, or Student variants, which have different earn structures). Discover's member-benefits page states that Discover Bank has merged into Capital One, N.A., and that some content may not apply to every card; Frequent Miler reports that some Discover it accounts have moved to Capital One servicing, where 5% activation is reached via the Capital One login (Rewards & Benefits > View Rewards). The discover.com 5% calendar page returned a client error on fetch and the alternate cashback-calendar.html loaded but displayed 'the rewards calendar is not working at this time', so quarterly category lists come from secondary sources and are marked verified false; the cap, activation requirement, base rate, Cashback Match, and welcome bonus were read on discover.com.

benefits.name: Cashback Match
benefits.period_note: Unlimited dollar-for-dollar match of all cash back earned from the day the new account is approved through the first 365 days; credited automatically within two billing periods after the match period ends
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Excludes rewards processed after the match period, statement credits, rewards transfers from Discover or Capital One deposit accounts, and rewards on closed accounts. New cardmembers only.

benefits.name: $200 bonus statement credit
benefits.period_note: Earn a $200 bonus statement credit when you spend $500 in the first 3 months
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: New cardmember welcome offer visible on the issuer product page; shown alongside Cashback Match

benefits.name: Q4 2026 5% Cashback Bonus categories: Restaurants, Entertainment, Utilities
benefits.period_note: 5% cash back on up to $1,500 in combined purchases in the quarter (maximum $75 cash back), then 1%; activation required and earning begins the day of activation (not retroactive to quarter start, per AwardWallet)
benefits.enrollment_note: Activate via the Discover cashback calendar or Discover app; for accounts moved to Capital One, log in, select the card, go to Rewards & Benefits > View Rewards, then the 5% calendar (per Frequent Miler). NerdWallet reports activation opened as early as Sept 1, 2026.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Restaurants: full-service restaurants, cafes, cafeterias, fast-food locations, caterers; restaurants inside hotels or retail stores and bakeries may not qualify. Entertainment: movie theaters, sports/theatrical/concert promoters, amusement parks, tourist attractions, aquariums, zoos, dance halls, record stores, video rental, pool halls, bowling alleys; excludes golf courses, country clubs, cable and streaming services, third-party amusement park tickets. Utilities: residential electricity, natural gas, water, and phone or online purchases of internet, cable, satellite TV, and mobile or landline phone service; purchases at physical retail stores do not qualify (merchant descriptions per Doctor of Credit).
benefits.verification_note: discover.com calendar page could not be fetched (client error) and the alternate cashback-calendar.html rendered 'the rewards calendar is not working at this time'. Categories and dates taken from NerdWallet, corroborated by Doctor of Credit and Frequent Miler. The $1,500 cap and activation requirement themselves were confirmed on discover.com.

benefits.name: $0 Fraud Liability
benefits.period_note: Cardmember is never responsible for unauthorized purchases on the Discover Card account, subject to investigation
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: An unauthorized purchase is one where the cardmember did not give card information to someone else for a charge

benefits.name: Freeze it (card lock)
benefits.period_note: Freeze the account in seconds with an on/off switch in the app or website; blocks new purchases and cash advances, while recurring merchant charges, payments, and returns may continue
benefits.verification_note: Read on discover.com 2026-10-28; the it-card.html page describes the same feature as 'Lock your card in the mobile app'

benefits.name: Free FICO Credit Score
benefits.period_note: Free FICO Credit Score plus score details, based on TransUnion data, for primary account holders; the it-card.html page frames this as a FICO Score 8 via CreditWise. Discover notes the benefit may change or end in the future.

benefits.name: Social Security Number alerts
benefits.period_note: Alert if the cardmember's Social Security Number is found on the dark web; free, online-only monitoring of the Experian credit report and dark web for primary cardmembers who opt in. Discover notes the benefit may change or end in the future.
